case.title: A lead change in Edit Work Order adds one Lead tech changed entry
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Technicians [Tech-A] and [Tech-B] (the expected results call them "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Audit" (this case only) with a contact and an asset.
  • One Approved work order [WO-1] with two approved lines that follow the lead (no technician of their own), led by [Tech-A].
  • Names and numbers are examples, except names the expected results quote, which must be used exactly.

Setup

  1. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: two, [Tech-A] and [Tech-B].
  2. Customer: Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Audit" > Save. On its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save. On its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model, Unit "TRK-118" > Save.
  3. Work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Audit" > its asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In New Line > "What Are You Doing?" type "grease" and pick "Service - Full grease service" (no parts) > Line Approved on > Save & Add Line; then type "clutch", pick "Service - Adjust clutch", Line Approved on > Save & Close. Write down the number (top left) as [WO-1] ("S1-716" in the expected results).
  4. On [WO-1], in the card at the left, pick [Tech-A] in Lead Technician (it saves at once; it can only be changed once the work order is Approved).
  5. Check: reload [WO-1]. Both lines' Labor rows show [Tech-A]. The history is at the three-dots button at the top right of the tabs > Audit Log (window "Work Order Log").
case.custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] (Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Audit" > click the work order) and open the Audit Log (three-dots at the top right of the tabs > Audit Log). Count the "Lead tech changed" entries and close the window (X).
  2. Note the time.
  3. There is no separate Edit Work Order window; the lead is changed on the status card (the card at the left of the work order page that shows the status, Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours).
  4. On the status card click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-B]. It saves at once.
  5. Open the Audit Log again.
  6. Read the newest entries.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Exactly one new "Lead tech changed" entry appears (count at step 1 + 1).
  • It names Esther Howard as the previous lead, Ralph Edwards as the new lead, your user, and the time you noted.
  • No separate entries appear for the two lines that followed the lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 1; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §7; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (S4-R9, S4-R17). Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 9 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat, given with screenshots after we reported that no Edit Work Order window opens for an existing work order. Part A, word for word: “For Lead technician. There are two places as appearing in the screenshots. The work order can not be edited directly, you edit their lines by navigating to the work order first and then by clicking each line on the work order. Yes the rest can be done from the cards appearing at the left on each work order. And Yes, ideally those checks use that card instead.” The lead change was moved to the status card on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply High 1: “Every lead change also adds a "Lead tech changed" history entry.”
  • QA handoff §7: “Each change adds exactly one "Lead tech changed" entry to the work order history.”
  • QA handoff §7: “This now also happens for changes made in Edit Work Order”
  • PRD S4-R9: “Every lead-change path records one audit entry with the previous lead, new lead, logged-in actor, and time.”
  • PRD S4-R17: “Do not create separate audit entries for implicit line movements caused by a lead change.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/9/2026.

changes.label: Preconditions
changes.old_value:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Regression Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. To create a work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the case customer and its asset > create it, and write down the number the build gives it (the numbers in this case are examples, e.g. "S1-702").
  7. To read the work order history: on the work order page click the three-dots button at the top right, then Audit Log. The window that opens is titled Work Order Log and lists Event, User, Line, Details, Date and Time.
  8. Create one work order for the case customer (e.g. "S1-716"), set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard", add two lines and approve them so the status reads Approved.

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard").
  2. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-B] (the expected results call this technician "Ralph Edwards"). Use a second, different technician.
  3. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Audit" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Audit" > Asset = its asset > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-716").
  5. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Add Line. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "clutch" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Adjust clutch" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close.
  6. On [WO-1], on the status card at the left, click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-A]. (Lead Technician is a dropdown only once the work order is Approved; while it is an Estimate it reads "Unassigned" and cannot be changed.) The choice saves at once.
  7. Check the setup worked: reload [WO-1]. Both lines' Labor rows show [Tech-A]. To read the history: click the three-dots button at the top right of the tabs > Audit Log; the window is titled Work Order Log with columns Event, User, Line, Details, Date, Time.
